intro: About 90% of Libya is desert, and it has the longest Mediterranean coastline of any African country.

chapters.title: Desert and coast
text: Almost everyone lives on the coast, around Tripoli and Benghazi. The Sahara covers the rest, with sand seas, volcanic Waw an Namus and the rock art of the Akakus mountains.
Libya has no permanent rivers. The Great Man-Made River pipes ancient groundwater from under the desert to the coast.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Libya is hot and dry; in 2023 Storm Daniel caused dams to burst at Derna, killing thousands.
